overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、收入分配与福利（1 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以优化方法、实验方法为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（6 篇）、arXiv（4 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: Comparative evaluation of artificial intelligence-integrated and conventional camera traps for small mammal monitoring
papers.abstract:
Context
                    Conventional camera traps generate vast amounts of non-target images that makes edge artificial intelligence (AI) cameras a promising solution for real-time species detection. However, the real-world effectiveness of these systems depends heavily on how models generalise from training to unpredictable field conditions.
                  
                  
                    Aims
                    We test whether within-distribution validation accuracy predicts field deployment performance for edge-deployed object detection models by examining how training-dataset background composition affects field generalisation for small mammal detection, and compare AI-integrated and conventional camera-trap detection outcomes under matched field conditions.
                  
                  
                    Methods
                    We conducted a field-based comparison between an AI-integrated camera system (MaixCAM-Pro running YOLOv11n) and a conventional trail camera (Hawkray HC-900A) for small mammal monitoring. Three object-detection models were evaluated based on training datasets with different background compositions: heterogeneous varied backgrounds (Model A), uniform white backgrounds (Model B) and a combined dataset integrating both (Model C).
                  
                  
                    Key results
                    Although Model B achieved the highest validation accuracy during training, field deployment revealed a severe performance gap. Model C demonstrated the strongest real-world performance, with 88.9% of MaixCAM-Pro captures correctly containing squirrels and a false-positive rate of 11.1%, markedly lower than Model A’s 98.4%. Conversely, Model A performed poorly in the field due to extensive background-related misclassifications. When the AI-integrated camera is equipped with Model C, it significantly reduces false triggers compared to the conventional camera while maintaining reliable small mammal (squirrel) detection.
                  
                  
                    Conclusions
                    Training-dataset background composition substantially affects field detection performance. The within-distribution validation accuracy does not reliably predict field deployment success. Balanced datasets incorporating both controlled and varied backgrounds are essential to improve model generalisation.
                  
                  
                    Implications
                    Wildlife AI applications must validate models under field conditions matching the deployment context rather than relying solely on training metrics. Furthermore, the model’s precision profile must align with the downstream ecological inference framework (e.g. occupancy modelling) to ensure data integrity.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**背景**  
传统的相机陷阱会生成大量非目标图像，这使得基于边缘计算的人工智能（AI）相机成为实时物种检测的有前景的解决方案。然而，这些系统在现实世界中的有效性在很大程度上取决于模型从训练数据到不可预测的野外环境中的泛化能力。  

**研究目的**  
我们通过研究训练数据集中的背景构成如何影响小型哺乳动物检测模型的野外泛化能力，来验证模型在分布范围内的验证准确率是否能够预测其在实际应用中的性能，并在相同的野外条件下比较集成AI的相机系统与传统相机陷阱系统的检测结果。  

**研究方法**  
我们对比了集成AI的相机系统（MaixCAM-Pro，运行YOLOv11n）与传统追踪相机（Hawkray HC-900A）在小型哺乳动物监测方面的表现。基于具有不同背景构成的训练数据集，评估了三种物体检测模型：异质多背景数据集（模型A）、均匀白色背景数据集（模型B）以及结合了这两种背景的数据集（模型C）。  

**主要结果**  
尽管模型B在训练期间的验证准确率最高，但在实际应用中其性能存在显著差距。模型C在现实世界中的表现最为出色，正确识别松鼠的准确率为88.9%，误报率为...。

papers.title: Techno-economic optimization and hybrid deep learning-based net-load forecasting for intelligent microgrid energy management using HOMER Pro
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  The integration of renewable energy resources into electrical grids has increased the need for replicable and cost-effective microgrid design and operation strategies. This paper presents a microgrid planning and energy management framework that combines HOMER Pro-based techno-economic optimization with hybrid deep learning-based forecasting. First, three microgrid configurations comprising photovoltaic (PV) generation, battery energy storage, diesel generation, and grid interconnection are modeled and evaluated based on economic, operational, and environmental performance. The optimal configuration identified using HOMER Pro is subsequently used as the reference architecture for a forecasting framework that employs recurrent neural networks and hybrid deep learning models to predict short-term building load demand and photovoltaic generation. The predicted load and PV generation are combined to estimate the future net-load, providing information that can support battery scheduling and grid interaction. The operational improvements discussed in this study are indicative of the potential benefits of forecast-informed operation and are not derived from a fully integrated forecast-driven dispatch implementation. The results demonstrate that combining HOMER Pro-based techno-economic analysis with hybrid deep learning forecasting provides a practical framework for supporting intelligent microgrid planning and predictive energy management.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
将可再生能源资源整合到电网中，增加了对可复制且具有成本效益的微电网设计与运营策略的需求。本文提出了一种微电网规划与能源管理框架，该框架结合了基于HOMER Pro的技术经济优化方法与基于混合深度学习的预测技术。首先，针对包含光伏发电、蓄电池储能、柴油发电以及电网互联三种类型的微电网配置，从经济性、运行性能和环境效益等方面进行了建模与评估。利用HOMER Pro确定的最佳配置作为参考架构，进一步构建了一个预测框架，该框架采用循环神经网络和混合深度学习模型来预测建筑物的短期负荷需求及光伏发电量。通过将预测得到的负荷数据与光伏发电量相结合，可以估算出未来的净负荷情况，从而为蓄电池的调度及电网互动提供决策依据。本研究探讨的运行优化措施体现了基于预测信息的运营方式所带来的潜在优势（这些优化并未基于完全集成的预测驱动调度系统来实现）。研究结果表明，将基于HOMER Pro的技术经济分析与混合深度学习预测技术相结合，能够为智能微电网规划及预测性能源管理提供实用的支撑框架。。研究方法：深度学习、神经网络、优化方法。

papers.title: Ownership and Non-Neutral Technological Change: Evidence from China's State-Owned Enterprise Privatization
papers.abstract: I estimate firm-level capital-, labor-, and material-augmenting productivity for Chinese manufacturing, 1998--2008, and the effect of state-owned enterprise (SOE) privatization on each. Results show technological change is strongly biased toward capital and labor. Private firms operate above SOEs on capital and labor, but below on materials. Privatization raises labor-augmenting productivity right after the transition, a front-loaded gain that fades on the full panel but persists among 1998 incumbents. It leaves capital-augmenting productivity no higher and modestly lowers materials. The SOE sector's catch-up runs through restructuring of the plants the state kept, with exit of overstaffed plants adding to the labor gain.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我估算了1998至2008年间中国制造业企业层面的资本密集型、劳动密集型和物质密集型生产率，以及国有企业（SOE）私有化对这三类生产率的影响。研究结果表明，技术进步在很大程度上偏向于资本和劳动要素。私营企业在资本和劳动生产率方面优于国有企业，但在物质生产率方面则低于国有企业。私有化在改革初期显著提升了劳动生产率，这种提升效应在后续数据中逐渐减弱，但在1998年就已存在的私营企业中仍持续存在。私有化并未提高资本密集型生产率，反而略微降低了物质密集型生产率。国有企业的生产率追赶主要通过对其保留的工厂进行重组来实现；那些人员过剩的工厂被淘汰后，进一步促进了劳动生产率的提升。。

papers.title: No Welfare Ties Between Pure-Strategy Nash Equilibria
papers.abstract: We show that distinct pure-strategy Nash equilibria typically have different utilitarian welfare values in sufficiently rich classes of $C^2$ games with open strategy sets. Here, typical means both generic and finitely prevalent, while rich means that the class admits a finite-dimensional family of perturbations that can independently move payoff values and first derivatives in any direction at any two distinct strategy profiles (for example, polynomial perturbations of degree at most three). Consequently, a welfare-maximizing equilibrium, if one exists, is unique. The result extends to each fixed $C^1$ payoff aggregator whose derivative with respect to the payoff vector is everywhere nonzero. In the full $C^2$ utility space, we also treat scalar criteria depending on strategies, payoffs, and payoff derivatives, subject to a nonvanishing condition in payoff-level or cross-player derivative directions. Finally, adjoining arbitrarily small perturbations from a suitable finite-dimensional space makes welfare separation typical in the augmented family, with separation holding for almost every perturbation of each fixed base game.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】我们证明了，在具有开放策略集的足够丰富的 $C^2$ 类型游戏中，不同的纯策略纳什均衡通常具有不同的效用价值。这里的“典型”既指具有普遍性的均衡，也指在样本中占比有限的均衡；而“丰富”则意味着该类别包含一类有限维的扰动方式，这些扰动可以独立地改变任意两个不同策略组合下的收益值及其一阶导数（例如，最高为三次的多项式扰动）。因此，如果存在一个能够最大化效用的均衡，那么这个均衡是唯一的。这一结论同样适用于所有那些对收益向量的一阶导数在任何地方都不为零的 $C^1$ 类型收益聚合函数。在完整的 $C^2$ 效用空间中，我们还研究了依赖于策略、收益及其导数的标量评价标准，并对这些标准施加了收益水平或跨玩家导数方向非零的条件。最后，通过从适当的有限维空间中引入任意小的扰动，我们发现增强后的均衡族中普遍存在效用分离现象，即对于每个基础游戏中的几乎所有扰动，这种分离关系都成立。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: ESG Performance, Corporate Governance, and Firm Value: The Mediating Role of Financial Sustainability new Emerging Markets in India
papers.abstract: Environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and corporate governance have become increasingly important in corporate valuation, particularly in emerging markets where institutional conditions influence sustainability practices and financial outcomes. However, the mechanisms through which these factors are associated with firm value require further empirical investigation. This study aims to examine the relationships among ESG performance, corporate governance, financial sustainability, and firm value in Indian listed companies, with particular attention to the mediating role of financial sustainability. The research employed a quantitative approach based on 720 firm-year observations of non-financial listed firms in India. Descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, multicollinearity diagnostics, fixed-effects panel regression, and mediation analysis with bootstrapped confidence intervals were applied. Firm value was measured using Tobin's Q, while financial sustainability was assessed through the Sustainable Growth Rate. The results revealed positive associations between ESG performance, corporate governance, and firm value. ESG performance and corporate governance were also positively associated with financial sustainability, which demonstrated a significant relationship with firm value (β = 1.842, p < 0.01). The inclusion of financial sustainability increased the explanatory power of the firm-value model from 41.2% to 48.6%. Mediation analysis identified significant indirect effects of ESG performance (β = 0.0052) and corporate governance (β = 0.1551) on firm value through financial sustainability, with confidence intervals excluding zero. These findings indicate that financial sustainability partially mediates the examined relationships and represents an important financial mechanism associated with corporate valuation. The study contributes to emerging-market research by integrating ESG performance, corporate governance, and financial sustainability within a unified analytical framework. Further research should examine individual ESG dimensions, sectoral differences, alternative measures of financial sustainability, and potential endogeneity to establish the robustness of these relationships across different institutional environments.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】环境、社会和治理（ESG）绩效与公司治理在企业估值中的重要性日益凸显，尤其是在制度环境对可持续发展实践和财务结果产生影响的新兴市场中。然而，这些因素与企业价值之间的关联机制仍需进一步的实证研究来探讨。本研究旨在分析印度上市公司的ESG绩效、公司治理、财务可持续性与企业价值之间的关系，特别关注财务可持续性的中介作用。研究采用了定量方法，基于印度720家非金融上市公司的年度数据进行分析，运用了描述性统计、相关性分析、多重共线性检验、固定效应面板回归以及带有自助法置信区间的中介分析等方法。企业价值通过托宾Q值（Tobin’s Q）来衡量，财务可持续性则通过可持续增长率（Sustainable Growth Rate）进行评估。研究结果表明，ESG绩效与公司治理与企业价值之间存在正相关关系；同时，ESG绩效与公司治理也与财务可持续性呈正相关，而财务可持续性与企业价值之间存在显著的正相关关系（β = 1.842，p < 0.01）。引入财务可持续性后，企业价值模型的解释能力从41.2%提升至48.6%。中介分析发现，ESG绩效（β = 0.0052）与公司治理（β = 0.1551）通过财...。研究方法：面板回归、回归分析。

papers.title: How Financial Inclusion Leads to Women Empowerment: Academic Journey from 2004 to 2026
papers.abstract: Financial inclusion not only facilitates the economic empowerment of women but also has profound consequences for gender equality and social empowerment. Previous empirical studies revealed the positive effect of financial inclusion on women’s empowerment, but bibliometric analysis in this context remains limited, especially in India. The purpose of this article is to study how financial inclusion influences women’s empowerment through a bibliometric analysis over the last two decades. The data were extracted from the Scopus database from 2004 to 2026, covering 22 years. Initially, 424 documents were identified, of which 369 documents were retained after screening through the PRISMA guidelines. The final dataset was analysed using Biblioshiny and VOSviewer software. The methodology includes various types of bibliometric analysis and science mapping to visualise the intellectual and conceptual structures, thematic development, collaboration patterns, keyword co-occurrence, co-citation, and bibliographic coupling. The analysis identifies India as the leading contributor, followed by the U.S.A. and the U.K. The findings reveal the most influential organisations, authors, sources, countries, and documents. Publication activity increased substantially after 2021, with 2025 being the most productive year. Financial inclusion and women’s empowerment are the most dominant research themes, while digital literacy, financial services, microfinance, and economic empowerment emerge as important areas of research. The study provides a comprehensive overview of the knowledge structure and research trends in financial inclusion and women’s empowerment. It also offers valuable insights to policymakers, who should focus on financial and digital literacy programmes, women’s access to smartphones, reliable internet connections, and digital banking. Future studies should use additional databases such as Web of Science, Dimensions, and Google Scholar, apply content analysis, examine rural and low-income contexts, and further investigate digital literacy, gender equality, financial inclusion, and economic empowerment.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】金融包容不仅有助于提升女性的经济能力，还对性别平等和社会赋权产生深远影响。先前的实证研究已经证明了金融包容对女性赋权的积极作用，但在此领域的文献计量分析仍然较为有限，尤其是在印度。本文旨在通过过去二十年的文献计量分析，探讨金融包容如何影响女性赋权。数据来源于Scopus数据库（2004年至2026年），共筛选出424篇文献，经PRISMA指南筛选后保留了369篇。最终数据集使用Biblioshiny和VOSviewer软件进行分析。研究方法包括多种文献计量分析手段及科学图谱绘制，以可视化知识体系、主题发展、合作模式、关键词共现、共同引用及文献之间的关联关系。分析结果显示，印度是该领域的主要贡献者，其次是美国和英国；最具影响力的机构、作者、国家及文献也得到了明确识别。2021年后出版活动显著增加，2025年成为产出最为丰富的年份。金融包容与女性赋权是研究的核心主题，同时数字素养、金融服务、小额信贷和经济赋权也成为重要的研究方向。本研究全面梳理了金融包容与女性赋权领域的知识结构与研究趋势，并为政策制定者提供了有益的启示——他们应重点关注金融与数字素养项目、女性获取智能手机的途径、可靠...。

papers.title: Qashqadaryo viloyati och tusli bo'z tuproqlarida ildizdan va barg orqali oziqlantirishning soya navlari o'suv davri davomiyligiga ta'siri
papers.abstract: Mazkur tadqiqotda Qashqadaryo viloyatining och tusli bo'z tuproqlarida o'stirilgan soya (Glycine max L.) ekinining Toshkent va Madad navlarining o'suv davri davomiyligiga turli o'g'it me'yorlari va suspenziya turlarining ta'siri o'rganildi. Tadqiqot jarayonida o'g'itlarning miqdori va tarkibi o'simliklarning o'sish bosqichlariga qanday ta'sir ko'rsatishi aniqlangan. Natijalar shuni ko'rsatdiki, o'g'it me'yori va suspenziya turlarining to'g'ri tanlanishi soya o'suv davrining optimal davomiyligini ta'minlab, hosildorlikni oshirishga xizmat qiladi. Olingan ma'lumotlar soya yetishtirish agrotexnikasini takomillashtirishda amaliy ahamiyatga ega.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在本研究中，探讨了在喀什噶尔省的灰褐色土壤中种植大豆（Glycine max L.）时，不同肥料施用方式和悬浮液类型对托什肯特（Toshkent）和马达德（Madad）品种生长周期的影响。研究过程中明确了肥料的数量和成分如何影响植物的不同生长阶段。结果表明，正确选择肥料施用方式和悬浮液类型能够确保大豆生长周期的最佳节奏，从而提高产量。所获得的数据对于改进大豆种植的农艺技术具有实际意义。。

papers.title: Algorithmic Bias in AI Marketing: Implications for Consumer Equity and Brand Reputation
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in targeting, personalization, pricing, recommendation, and content-generation systems, intensifying concerns about algorithmic bias and its consequences for consumers and brands. This critical literature review synthesizes peer-reviewed and applied research published primarily between 2017 and 2025 to examine how bias enters AI-enabled marketing through data, model design, optimization objectives, and deployment contexts. The synthesis identifies three recurring mechanisms data, model, and contextual bias and shows how they can produce representational, measurement, and evaluation disparities. Across the reviewed literature, these disparities are associated with discriminatory targeting, exclusion, opaque personalization, perceived unfairness, and erosion of consumer trust, with downstream risks for brand legitimacy and reputation. The review further integrates technical, organizational, and regulatory mitigation approaches, including data audits, fairness-aware modeling, explainable AI, human oversight, governance structures, impact assessment, and regulatory compliance. The article contributes an integrated socio-technical perspective that connects the AI lifecycle to consumer-equity outcomes and reputational consequences. It concludes that responsible AI marketing requires fairness and accountability to be treated as design and governance objectives rather than post-hoc corrections.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】人工智能（AI）正越来越多地应用于目标定位、个性化服务、定价、推荐系统以及内容生成领域，这引发了人们对算法偏见及其对消费者和品牌影响的担忧。本文对2017年至2025年间发表的同行评审及应用研究进行了系统梳理，探讨了偏见如何通过数据、模型设计、优化目标及应用场景渗透到基于AI的营销活动中。研究总结了三种常见的偏见机制：数据偏见、模型偏见和情境偏见，并分析了这些偏见如何导致在数据表示、测量结果及评估标准方面的不公平现象。在所研究的文献中，这些偏见问题与歧视性目标定位、用户排斥、不透明的个性化服务、消费者感知到的不公平体验以及消费者信任度的下降密切相关，进而对品牌的合法性和声誉造成负面影响。文章还提出了技术性、组织性和监管性的应对措施，包括数据审计、公平性导向的模型设计、可解释性AI技术、人工监督、治理结构构建、影响评估以及合规性要求。本文从社会技术的角度出发，将AI的整个生命周期与消费者权益及品牌声誉的后果联系起来，认为负责任的AI营销应将公平性和透明度作为核心设计原则与治理目标，而不仅仅是事后的修正措施。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Strengthening Tarif Principles Embeddedness in Pertamina's STK: A Governance Assessment of Framework
papers.venue: Journal of Business Social and Technology
papers.abstract:
Background: Corporate governance is effective only when policy-level principles are translated into observable operational requirements. In large state-owned enterprises, strong formal governance can coexist with incomplete procedural embeddedness, creating a governance translation gap.
Objective: This study evaluates the embeddedness of Transparency, Accountability, Responsibility, Independency, and Fairness (TARIF) principles in PT Pertamina (Persero)’s Sistem Tata Kerja (STK), using procurement planning as a pilot case.
Methods: An action-research-oriented qualitative case design combined systematic document analysis, corporate risk and governance records, and practitioner validation. Nine procedural elements were mapped against five TARIF principles, producing 45 element–principle combinations rated as present, partial, enhancement opportunity, or not applicable.
Results: Overall governance coverage was 56%. Responsibility was the strongest principle, at 89%, whereas Independency was the weakest, at 11%, revealing gaps in conflict-of-interest controls, separation of duties, and independent review. The most consequential gaps occurred in needs identification and supporting documentation for vendor selection. Alternative C+ received the strongest overall evaluation.
Conclusion: The findings show that governance quality should be assessed not only through policy-level compliance but also through explicit procedural mechanisms. The TARIF-to-STK Governance Enhancement Framework operationalizes the policy-to-procedure distance and provides a structured basis for targeted improvement. Theoretically, it extends governance assessment toward procedure-level embeddedness; practically, it supports repeatable STK review and prioritization. Because the evidence derives from a single procurement-planning case, broader applicability requires validation across other STKs and longitudinal assessment of implementation effects.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**背景**：企业治理只有在政策层面的原则被转化为可观察的操作要求时才能真正发挥作用。在大型国有企业中，虽然形式上的治理体系较为完善，但程序层面的嵌入程度往往不够充分，从而形成了治理体系转换的“缺口”。

**目的**：本研究以PT Pertamina（Persero）的“工作体系”（Sistem Tata Kerja, STK）为例，评估“透明度、问责制、责任性、独立性及公平性”（Transparency, Accountability, Responsibility, Independence, Fairness, TARIF）原则在该体系中的实际嵌入情况。

**方法**：本研究采用行动研究导向的定性案例设计方法，结合系统化的文件分析、企业风险与治理记录以及实践者的反馈进行评估。将九个程序要素与TARIF原则进行对照，得出45种要素-原则组合，并对这些组合进行“存在”、“部分存在”、“需要改进”或“不适用”的评级。

**结果**：整体治理覆盖率为56%。其中，“责任性”原则的落实程度最高（89%），而“独立性”原则的落实程度最低（11%），主要问题体现在利益冲突控制、职责...。

papers.title: KWSSWS-IA Approach: An Intelligent Assistant for Scientific PDF Retrieval Using Semantic Analysis and AI-Driven Summarization
papers.abstract: In the age of excessive information, traditional web search engines frequently fall short in providing accurate, contextually relevant results for scientific research. Furthermore, in addition to metadata-based retrieval, this study presents an enhanced version of the Keyword Search System on Web Searching (KWSSWS), which has evolved into an Intelligent Assistant (KWSSWS-IA) capable of deep semantic analysis of full-text PDF documents. The proposed system uses transformer-based artificial intelligence (AI) models related to natural language processing (NLP) to obtain and analyze internal document components, including title, abstract, keywords, and conclusions. It automatically generates brief, accurate summaries which is associated with ranks results according to scientific relevance rather than keyword frequency, in addition to recognizing significant scientific entities like authors, publication year, journal, and domain-specific terms KWSSWS-IA presents the following results on a single screen: download link, AI-generated summary, keyword match supplied by the user, publication year, title, and authors, and source journal. Therefore, ordinary search interfaces just offer hyperlinks. Experimental evaluation reveals significant improvements in precision, recall, and utilizer efficiency compared to standard Google Scholar searches. In addition, researchers who  remain  short on time and seeking high-quality, domain-relevant literature may find the strategy particularly useful.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在信息过量的时代，传统的网页搜索引擎往往难以为科学研究提供准确且具有上下文相关性的搜索结果。本研究在基于元数据的检索方法的基础上，对“Web Searching中的关键词搜索系统”（KWSSWS）进行了改进，将其发展为具备深度语义分析能力的智能辅助工具（KWSSWS-IA），能够处理完整的PDF文档。该系统运用与自然语言处理（NLP）相关的人工智能（AI）模型来提取和分析文档的各个组成部分，包括标题、摘要、关键词和结论。它能够自动生成简洁准确的摘要，并根据科学相关性而非关键词频率对搜索结果进行排序。此外，KWSSWS-IA还能识别作者、出版年份、期刊以及领域特定术语等重要的科学实体。用户可以在一个界面上看到以下信息：下载链接、AI生成的摘要、用户输入的关键词匹配结果、出版年份、标题、作者以及来源期刊。而普通的搜索界面通常仅提供超链接。实验评估表明，与标准的Google Scholar搜索相比，该系统在精确度、召回率和用户效率方面均有显著提升。对于时间紧张且需要查找高质量、领域相关文献的研究人员来说，这一工具尤为实用。。研究方法：Transformer 模型、自然语言处理、实验方法。

papers.title: Exponential investors with weakly mean-reverting prices
papers.abstract: We investigate a continuous-time financial market where the asset price exhibits weak (sublinear) mean reversion and has a nonzero drift. Complementing earlier work on strong (superlinear) mean reversion, we show that, for an investor maximizing expected exponential utility, the certainty equivalent grows as $O(T^{2β+1})$ where $0<β<1$ is the strength of mean reversion. An explicit asymptotically optimal strategy is also given.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个连续时间金融市场，在该市场中，资产价格表现出弱（亚线性）均值回归特性，并且存在非零的漂移。作为对之前关于强（超线性）均值回归研究的补充，我们发现，对于一个旨在最大化预期指数效用的投资者而言，其确定性等价物（certainty equivalent）的增长速度为$O(T^{2β+1})$，其中$0<β<1$表示均值回归的强度。我们还给出了一个明确的渐近最优投资策略。。

papers.title: Measuring Gift Card Program Incrementality via Causal Data Fusion
papers.abstract: Businesses regularly offer gift card programs to drive customer spending and increase engagement. A central question is how much incremental revenue these programs generate, and which channels drive it most efficiently. Measuring the incremental revenue associated with a gift card program is a challenging problem in causal inference, requiring a firm to infer how much each customer would have spent if they never received a gift card. Observational data on past customer purchasing behavior reveal possession of a gift card only when a customer makes a purchase, thus leaving a customer's treatment status systematically censored.   In this paper, we develop a novel data fusion approach to overcome this missing data challenge. We identify and estimate incrementality by combining a large observational dataset with a smaller experimental dataset from a different population. Our approach relies on a mild transferability condition, which posits that the conditional relative treatment effect of gift card receipt on the decision to purchase is invariant across the two populations. We develop a flexible, machine learning-based estimator for the incremental revenue and establish its asymptotic normality.   We apply our estimator across both first- and third-party channels through which Airbnb distributes gift cards, finding heterogeneity in incrementality across segments of the population. In particular, we find not only that third-party channels are more incremental than first-party ones, but also that "self-gifters" (i.e., customers likely to have purchased their own gift cards) are more incremental than the broader population.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】企业经常推出礼品卡计划，以促进客户消费并提高客户参与度。一个核心问题是这些计划能带来多少额外收入，以及哪些渠道能够最有效地实现这一目标。在因果推断中，衡量礼品卡计划所带来的额外收入是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为需要推断出如果客户从未收到礼品卡，他们原本会花费多少钱。关于客户过往购买行为的观察数据仅能在客户实际进行消费时显示其是否持有礼品卡，因此客户的处理状态存在系统性缺失（即数据被“截断”）。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的数据融合方法来克服这一数据缺失问题。通过结合大规模的观察数据集和来自不同人群的较小规模实验数据集，我们识别并估算了额外收入的增量效应。我们的方法基于一个温和的可转移性假设，即礼品卡接收对购买决策的条件相对影响在两个群体中是不变的。我们开发了一种基于机器学习的灵活估计器来计算额外收入，并证明了其渐近正态性。我们将该估计器应用于Airbnb分发礼品卡的两种渠道（第一方渠道和第三方渠道），发现不同人群群体之间的额外收入存在差异。具体而言，我们发现第三方渠道带来的额外收入高于第一方渠道；同时，“自我赠送礼品卡”的客户（即那些可能自己购买礼品卡的客户）所带来的额外收入也高于...。研究方法：因果推断、机器学习、实验方法。
